tax.text: She favors restraint in federal spending and says federal finances cannot be fixed by continually raising taxes.
tax.quote: Her argument is straightforward: you cannot fix this country’s finances by raising taxes forever.

trade.text: She rejects a freer-trade approach for imported seafood and supports country-of-origin labeling, equal inspections and enforcement of existing trade laws.
trade.quote: That is not free trade. That is one set of rules for our families and another set for everybody else.

debt.text: She supports fiscal reform and spending discipline while saying that fixing federal finances should not cut the benefits or care people depend on.
debt.quote: Fixing the books is not the same thing as cutting the care.

housing.text: She says increasing the housing supply is the solution to expensive housing and would address barriers that slow construction.
housing.quote: The solution to expensive housing is more housing. Lisa opposes federal rent and price controls as the primary answer.

health.text: She calls for more competition and less administrative burden in health care rather than another federal bureaucratic layer.
health.quote: Patients should know what their care and their prescriptions actually cost, before they receive a bill. We need more competition, less unnecessary administrative burden, and a system where healthcare dollars reach patients and the people treating them instead of being consumed by the machinery in between.

energy.text: She supports domestic energy production and says Louisiana should have some of the country’s cheapest household energy.
energy.quote: Cheap Energy Louisiana should be one of the cheapest places in America to power a home.

tax.text: He said he would advocate for tax breaks for working-class people and stable prices for food, health care, and insurance.
tax.quote: Advocate for lower and fairer tax breaks for the working class equal to the wealthy.

abortion.text: He supported limiting elective abortion to life-threatening medical circumstances, rape, or incest, with strict enforcement of those exceptions.
abortion.quote: Legislation that strictly enforce the rules exceptions for medical life threatening situations for mother, Rape or Incest
